name: ClamAV
description: ClamAV is an open-source antivirus engine for detecting trojans, viruses and other malware. It scans bind-mounted folders such as download or share directories as files arrive and/or daily, and can optionally serve clamd over TCP so Nextcloud, rspamd or mail servers share one scanner. Infected files are reported, never moved or deleted.

app_vars.name: var_scan_dir
app_vars.label: Scan Folder
app_vars.help: Absolute path inside the container that is watched and/or scanned daily; bind-mount host folders here

app_vars.name: var_scan_host_dir
app_vars.label: Host Folder to Scan
app_vars.help: Optional folder on the Proxmox host; mounted read-only into the scan folder after the install (asked at the end when empty)

app_vars.name: var_scan_mode
app_vars.label: Scan Mode
app_vars.help: watch: scan files as they are written or moved in; daily: full scan once a day; both: watch plus a daily full rescan

app_vars.name: var_clamd_tcp
app_vars.label: clamd over TCP (port 3310)
app_vars.help: Let other hosts send files to clamd on port 3310, e.g. Nextcloud files_antivirus or rspamd

notes.text: Pick a host folder at install (var_scan_host_dir) and it is bind-mounted read-only into the scan folder. Results go to /var/log/clamav/scan.log; signatures update hourly.
clamd on TCP 3310 has no authentication. Allow the port only from the hosts that use it, e.g. with the Proxmox firewall.
In an unprivileged container, only files readable by others on the host can be scanned. Watch mode does not see changes made on NFS or SMB mounts.
